# Bhanu Mendis — Official Website

## Identity

Bhanu Mendis (Sinhala: භානු මෙන්ඩිස්) is a Sri Lankan educator, performing artist, audio engineer, and public speaker based in Colombo (Boralesgamuwa), Sri Lanka. He currently teaches Science, Mathematics and Computing on the Pearson Edexcel curriculum at The Science Brainery.

## Tutoring & Classes (Primary Current Focus)

Bhanu Mendis offers private tuition as an Educator at The Science Brainery, Boralesgamuwa.

- Subjects: Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Mathematics, and Computing / ICT
- Syllabus: Pearson Edexcel (Pearson International)
- Grades / Years: 6, 7 and 8
- Class formats: Group classes and Individual (one-to-one) classes

## Current Roles

- Educator at The Science Brainery (Sep 2025 – present) — teaching Pearson Edexcel Science, Mathematics and Computing for Grades 6–8, group and individual classes
- Sangeetha Visharadha — qualified classical Indian music specialist (First Division, Bathkandhe Sangit Vidhyapith)

## Professional Background

### Leadership
- Senior Head Prefect, Lyceum International School Nugegoda (Sep 2023 – Sep 2025)
- Directed Elysium '25 graduation ceremony at Cinnamon Life – City of Dreams for 26,000+ Lyceumers nationwide
- Overall Coordinator, Maathra 14 at BMICH — managed 750+ performers
- Appointed National Child Protection Ambassador (2024–2025)
- Head Prefect (2023–2024)

### Music & Arts
- Founder of Swara Concert — the largest island-wide school-based Eastern music concert in Sri Lanka, showcasing 700+ participants from all Lyceum branches
- Founder of Padura Concert — original instrumental music concert series
- Founding President, Eastern Music Club, Lyceum International School
- Senior Chorister, Senior Choir — 8 years
- Certified Audio Engineer, PEARLBAY® Holdings (Oct 2025 – Mar 2026)

### Education & Certifications
- Cambridge GCE O/Level: A* Sinhala, A Physics, A Mathematics, A Biology
- Sangeetha Visharadha — Indian Music, First Division (2023)
- Diploma in Western Music, Lyceum International School (2023)
- Diploma in Information Technology, ESOFT Metro Campus (2022)
- Aviation Course, Sri Lanka Air Force, Ratmalana
- Professional Compering, Institute of Media & Performing Arts
- Leadership Award, Institute for Professional Development (2022)

### Model UN
- Head of Logistics, LISMUN & SLMUN (Dec 2023 – Dec 2024)
